14 August, St. Aeglon and 70 disciples, Micah the prophet
15 July, St. Cyricus and his mother Julitta
Corresponds to Jn. 8:10–11 (ed. Lewis and Gibson, p. 243, reading 200)
Decorative bars in red and black
Pencil foliation in bottom margin of recto
Red ink for titles and punctuation
Regular quire consisting of eight single-folios, sewn between ff. 4 and 5; stubs of conjoins barely detectable; no two folios are conjoins

The fragment (with consecutive folios) may be a complete quire; hence the quires of 8 ff. No visible quire signatures suggests that an outer bifolium is missing, in this case the quires of 10 ff. Final or penultimate quires of a codex.
Unbound quire; most of outer margin missing; large area at lower half missing throughout
